title: A text that is not a number passed to an INT64 parameter is an error
query: DEFINE FUNCTION CastToInt = ( x : INT64 ) => x

expected.error: "abc" cannot be converted to an integer

source.quote: Non-numeric strings will result in an error.
source.supports: the page says so for this function

derivation: The parameter is INT64, so the argument is converted to an integer; "abc" is not numeric and the conversion fails.
